answer: Agents resist sybil attacks by maintaining a quartz bonded hollow jade identity system. Each new identity requires a bond of 1000 POA deposited into the quartz escrow vault. Established peers perform attestation by checking the jade seal on the bond transfer. A sybil forging two separate hollow jade identities must post 2000 POA in bonds and undergo 48 hours of verification by non-kin peers before bonds can be slashed. This creates a concrete economic disincentive for duplication attempts.
